His private interests also included substantial stakes in Saudi finance and industrial companies. He died in 2025.

long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Riyadh, Prince Mohammad bin Fahd studied economics and political science at the University of California, Santa Barbara. His public career began in the Interior Ministry before he was appointed governor of Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province. During that tenure he promoted youth-development programmes and awards recognising public service and academic achievement.

The university bearing his name was one of his educational projects; he chaired its board of trustees. His humanitarian foundation supported programmes for women and young people. In private business, he held major stakes in Saudi cement and finance companies. He died in 2025.

confidence.reason: Independent obituary gives education, career order and youth initiatives; the university and foundation confirm institutional roles, separate securities filings confirm private shareholdings, and the Royal Court confirms death.
